sources.quote: This record is the complete list of approved material sources for the parts, plants and customers in scope.
BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
A supplier audit result does not grant a part approval.

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL completely and lists only Alluminio B. Meccanica C holds approvals only for BR-180 and BR-310, so it has no approval for BR-220. The passed audit and revoked probation do not grant a part approval.

sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
8.3.6.1 Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the STL CSR. A new material source, and a different material from the drawing, needs written STL approval before shipment. No such approval is in the documents.

sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
Root cause not confirmed. A material-related contribution has not been excluded.
Effectiveness verification not yet completed. Report status: OPEN.

findings.why: Meccanica C has an OPEN 8D on EN AW-6061-T6 brackets with cracked fastener holes. This is the same alloy and billet that is now offered for BR-220, which also has 4 fastener holes. Material contribution is not excluded.

sources.quote: 1. Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).
Rev B is superseded and withdrawn as of 2026-06-01.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The drawing in force (Rev C) requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). The offered EN AW-6061-T6 is a different grade. The email's 6061 / 240 MPa statement comes from the superseded Rev B and is not valid. Rev C changed the material and raised the yield requirement.

sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
5. Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.

findings.why: The only support for the claim that 6061 strength is equivalent to 6082 is the supplier's statement. No EN 10204 3.1 certificate or tensile result for the offered billet is in the documents, so SC-01 (Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa) cannot be assessed. A person must obtain this evidence.
